title: Reef Stalker Sport Fishing Charters

Fishing targets include walleye and perch with big fish 5-12 lbs common
Ohio fishing license must be brought by guest
Can handle groups big or small, from 1 to 100
includes: Lunch, beverages, snacks, and fish cleaning

gap: Price per person or per group not stated
blurb: Guests take full-day fishing charters on a 30' Sport Craft boat on Lake Erie, targeting species like walleye and perch. Trips run from 6am with no dock-to-dock time limit and include lunch, beverages, snacks, and fish cleaning. The boat is fully equipped and Coast Guard approved, operating September through November in Huron, Ohio.
extraNote: $100 deposit holds charter · Drug use will terminate trip immediately · The Fisherman’s Wharf, 83 Madison Street, Port Clinton, OH · September thru November
